description.value: Sashimiya is a grab-and-go sushi and sashimi shop founded by Tokyo-born Chef Taka Omi, a veteran of the Fairmont Royal York and Fairmont Vancouver's RawBar. The shop stocks premium sashimi-grade fish alongside Japanese pantry staples — rice, nori, miso, soy sauce — making it a destination for both ready-to-eat meals and home cooking supplies. It has been featured by Eater, the Globe & Mail, and other outlets as one of Vancouver's essential takeout stops.

bike_parking_detail: 2 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 35m; stands (4 spaces) at 52m. Total: 6 spaces.

Sashimiya is a grab-and-go sushi/sashimi shop that also stocks Japanese grocery and snack items (rice, nori, miso, soy sauce), supporting a 'Groceries' category, though OSM's 'supermarket' tag overstates its scope.
